VacancyDetail.title: Supervisor
VacancyDetail.company_desc: We are a developing manufacturer of toilet and household soap, as well as laundry powder. Our goal is to provide clients with high-quality products that make their lives more comfortable and cleaner. Join our team and contribute to the company's success!
VacancyDetail.looking_for: We are looking for an energetic and determined leader! Join our team and reach new heights with us if you have the following qualities:
VacancyDetail.quality_1: Leadership skills and ability to motivate the team.
VacancyDetail.quality_4: Ability to make decisions quickly and solve problems.
VacancyDetail.quality_7: Willingness to work in highly competitive conditions.
VacancyDetail.expect_1: 2+ years of experience as a supervisor or head of sales department.
VacancyDetail.expect_2: Successful experience managing a team and achieving high sales results.
VacancyDetail.expect_3: Knowledge of the Dushanbe and RRP market and understanding of the high competition market.
VacancyDetail.expect_5: Ability to analyze data and develop strategies to increase sales.
VacancyDetail.expect_6: Readiness for intensive work and solving complex tasks.
VacancyDetail.important_desc: This position requires high determination and willingness to work in highly competitive conditions. We are looking for people focused on results and ready for challenges.
VacancyDetail.resp_1: Leadership and coordination of sales team work responsible for a specific territory in Dushanbe and RRP
VacancyDetail.resp_2: Setting goals and tasks for employees, monitoring their completion.
VacancyDetail.resp_3: Knowledge of the Dushanbe and RRP market and understanding of the specifics of working in a highly competitive market.
VacancyDetail.resp_4: Team management and support, development of their professional skills
VacancyDetail.resp_5: Ability to analyze data and develop strategies to increase sales.
VacancyDetail.resp_6: Readiness for intensive work and solving complex tasks.
VacancyDetail.interested_desc: Fill in all the necessary information and upload your resume. We will contact you as soon as possible!
